name: Agroforestry component under RKVY
nodalDept: Contact the official scheme portal for details
briefDescription: This scheme promotes agroforestry on farmlands, encouraging tree plantation alongside agricultural crops to enhance farm income and environmental sustainability.
descriptionMd: The Agroforestry component under RKVY, part of the Sub-Mission on Agroforestry launched in 2016-17, encourages farmers to integrate tree plantations with their agricultural crops. This initiative aims to diversify farm income sources and significantly expand the overall tree cover across farmlands. It also plays a crucial role in promoting enhanced carbon sequestration, contributing to both climate change adaptation and mitigation efforts.
benefitsMd:
*   Increased farm income for participating farmers.
*   Expansion of national tree cover through farmland plantations.
*   Enhanced carbon sequestration, supporting climate change adaptation.
*   Contribution to climate change mitigation efforts.
eligibilityMd:
*   Applicant must possess farmlands suitable for agroforestry.
*   Applicant must be engaged in agricultural activities on their land.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
